purpose: Active dense pad-resolved representation required before closed-loop curiosity training.

candidate_provenance_fields.candidate.newton_mjw.Fn: candidate direct normal force from Newton/MJWarp bridge
candidate_provenance_fields.candidate.newton_mjw.Ft: candidate direct tangential/shear force from Newton/MJWarp bridge
candidate_provenance_fields.candidate.newton_mjw.area_proxy: point-contact-density proxy, not validated real contact area
candidate_provenance_fields.candidate.newton_mjw.marker_flow: candidate render derived from force/proxy fields, not photometric GelSight output
candidate_provenance_fields.candidate.newton_mjw.contact_normal: candidate contact normal from Newton/MJWarp contact frame
